title: Juicy Crispy British Potato Crumble
description: An earthy and juicy crowd-pleaser featuring a crumbly topping of bread crumbs and spices on roasted potatoes, perfect for a simple yet satisfying side dish.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: waxy potatoes like King Edwards or Maris Piper are recommended

ingredients.name: cinnamon
ingredients.notes: optional, to complement the natural sweetness of the potatoes

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Wash and peel potatoes, then slice them into rounds about 1/8-inch thick.

In a large skillet with oil over medium heat, fry potato slices for about 2-3 minutes until golden brown on one side. Turn and continue frying until evenly golden and crisp. Remove from skillet and set aside.

Melt butter in the same skillet over low-medium heat. Stir in sugar, cinnamon (if using), flour, and oats. Mix well to form a smooth paste. Add cold unsalted butter pieces and mix until crumbly and spreadable.
Spread evenly on top of fried potatoes. Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and crisp on top.
Serve hot with soups, stews, or as a side to any main course. Garnish with a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
